mapper.select: select a.asset_Id as assetId, b.name as assetName, b.ASSET_MODE as assetMode, b.ip as assetIp, ROUND(a.TIMEDURATION / 86400, 0) as duration from COLLECT_SYSTEM_TIME a left join ASSET b ON a.asset_Id = b.id

select assetId, assetName, assetMode, assetIp, duration, num from ( select a.asset_Id as assetId, b.name as assetName, b.ASSET_MODE as assetMode, b.ip as assetIp, ROUND(a.TIMEDURATION / 86400, 0) as duration, rownum as num from COLLECT_SYSTEM_TIME a join ASSET b ON a.asset_Id = b.id where b.IS_DEL = 1 order by a.asset_Id asc ) c where c.num between ((#{pageIndex} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) and (#{pageIndex} * #{pageSize})
